editorial.description_en: Under a stand of cedar, where the light arrives already green.
editorial.description_ja: 杉林の下のような、暗く落ち着いた緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.654, C 0.044, h 152.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 杉 (sugi, cedar) + 影 (kage, shadow). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Cedar Shadow" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 杉影. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ja-mon at ΔE00 4.8, kawa-goke at ΔE00 5.8, numa-omote at ΔE00 8.2. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
